units.title: Introduction to Database System and SQL commands
topics: 1.1. Concepts and Definitions: Database and database systems and database environment
1.2. Data, Information, Data Item or Fields, Records, Files, Metadata, Data dictionary and it’s components,
1.5. Database Language commands: Data Definition Language (DDL): CREATE, ALTER, TRUNCATE, DROP
